findings.title: Load plans are signed off by the shift supervisor, not the certified load controller
findings.detail: Types: Different role, Skipped check. Impact: safety exposure on wide-body turns. Verdict: Risky drift.
findings.source_note: Rests on 1 document, 4 interviews, system records of 10 cases.

findings.title: Two load-planning systems have run in parallel since the merger
findings.detail: Types: Duplicate work. Impact: double entry on every departure. Verdict: Obsolete rule.

findings.title: Renewal pricing: approved by the country manager in Belmar, by the regional finance controller in Arden
findings.detail: Types: Different role. Step S-07 (Approve the renewal price). Reason: Belmar kept its pre-merger delegation of authority.
findings.source_note: Compared between the two published maps of VS-01; each side rests on 3 interviews.

findings.title: Overtime is approved by the station manager without the regional roster owner
findings.detail: Types: Different role. Impact: roster decisions made twice. Verdict: Unexplained.
